summary: Enforce at most one open infrastructure-health incident per component in the incidents service by merging subsequent open events and recording merged incident aliases, resolve all sibling open infrastructure incidents for a component on recovery, and reconcile orphaned open infrastructure incidents for currently healthy unreferenced components on every BFF health monitor probe cycle with resolution_reason=orphan_recovered.
scope: services/incident/incident.py: add ORPHAN_RECOVERED_RESOLUTION_REASON, normalize_infrastructure_component, strict is_infrastructure_health_incident classification, extract_infrastructure_incident_component, extract_infrastructure_incident_referenced_ids, IncidentStore.find_open_infrastructure_incidents_for_component, find_infrastructure_incident_by_id_or_alias, merge_infrastructure_incident_into_open, upsert_open_infrastructure_incident, resolve_open_infrastructure_incidents_for_component, resolve_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents, re-entrant _write_guard, and resolution_reason token detection in update_incident_status
services/incident/pg_store.py: implement PostgresIncidentStore.upsert_open_infrastructure_incident with compare-and-set retry and refresh

services/incidents/consumer.py: preserve exact incident_id replay (200) and conflicting source_event_id rejection (409), support merged alias replay/conflict verification, merge second open events for the same component into the open incident via upsert_open_infrastructure_incident, and support component recovery payloads

services/incidents/main.py: resolve merged infrastructure incident aliases in _get_or_404, resolve all sibling open infrastructure incidents for the same component on status update to resolved/closed with prepared + activated postmortem outbox delivery, and add POST /api/incidents/reconcile-infrastructure-health

services/control-plane/bff/downstream_health_monitor.py: add has_active_incident_delivery on _DurableHealthStore, add reconcile_orphaned_incidents and reconcile_orphaned_incidents_sync on DownstreamHealthMonitor, and invoke orphan reconciliation off the event loop in _probe_all on every probe cycle

services/incidents/test_infrastructure_orphan_recovery.py: regression tests for AC1-AC5 including the 6-component hosted dev reproduction (governance, capital, deployment, promotion, consultation, research-orchestrator)
services/incident/test_incident.py: unit tests for strict infrastructure incident classification, open incident upsert/merge, and orphan reconciliation
services/incident/test_pg_store_integration.py: Postgres integration test for upsert_open_infrastructure_incident and resolve_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents
services/incidents/test_main_routes.py: route tests for second open event merge, alias resolution, and POST /api/incidents/reconcile-infrastructure-health
services/control-plane/bff/test_downstream_health_monitor.py: unit test for reconcile_orphaned_incidents_sync and stuck resolving ledger cleanup
services/control-plane/bff/test_bff_downstream_health_monitor.py: unit test verifying _probe_all invokes orphan reconciliation with healthy targets
services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_lifespan_background_work.py: lifespan integration test verifying orphaned infrastructure incidents resolve within one probe interval

acceptance_criteria_verification.ac1: The incidents service keeps at most one open infrastructure incident per component and merges a second open event for the same component into the existing open incident while recording merged_incident_id alias metadata; verified in test_ac1_second_open_event_merges_into_existing_open_incident, test_upsert_open_infrastructure_incident_merges_second_open_event, and test_consume_infrastructure_health_second_open_event_merges_and_resolves_via_alias.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac2: A recovery event or status resolution for a component (by primary incident_id, merged alias, or component recovery payload) resolves every open infrastructure incident of that component including incidents opened before a monitor ledger reset; verified in test_ac2_recovery_resolves_every_open_incident_for_component_including_pre_reset.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac3: Open infrastructure incidents whose component is currently healthy and that no active BFF health ledger row references are resolved within one probe interval with resolution_reason=orphan_recovered in evidence_summary and resolution_reason:orphan_recovered in telemetry_event_ids; verified in test_ac3_reconcile_resolves_unreferenced_open_incidents_for_healthy_components, test_reconcile_infrastructure_health_resolves_orphaned_healthy_component, and test_lifespan_monitor_reconciles_orphaned_infrastructure_incidents_within_one_interval.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac4: Regression tests reproduce the hosted dev case where an earlier open incident for a component (governance, capital, deployment, promotion, consultation, research-orchestrator) lost its ledger mapping and a later incident for the same component opened and resolved while the earlier one stayed open; after the fix both end resolved; verified in test_ac4_hosted_dev_six_component_orphan_reproduction_and_resolution and test_hosted_dev_reproduction_end_to_end_within_one_probe_interval.
acceptance_criteria_verification.ac5: is_infrastructure_health_incident strictly scopes deduplication, sibling resolution, and orphan reconciliation to non-trading infrastructure-health incidents so monitor-agent finding, runtime, drift, and deployment incidents are completely unaffected; verified in test_ac5_non_infrastructure_incidents_are_unaffected and test_is_infrastructure_health_incident_strict_scope.

test_expectation_classification.details: All pre-existing unit, route, lifespan, and Postgres integration tests across services/incident, services/incidents, and services/control-plane/bff pass without weakening existing expectations. New unit, route, lifespan, and end-to-end regression tests were added for AC1-AC5.
